## Memory leak fixed

- RAM no longer climbs into the gigabytes when the app is left running - it builds up because
  every adb call used to open a fresh connection and never release it (confirmed live: threads
  grew from 335 to 772 in 90 seconds before the fix, flat at 111 after)
- Logcat capture no longer buffers the whole session in memory

See [CHANGES.md](https://github.com/TonciZ/QA-Adbpad/blob/main/CHANGES.md) for details.
